    Sparse arrow corrections for contour functions #

    Formalize the elementary arrow-supported corrections used in the local cases of the BGRS clinging lemma. A Boolean selector marks arrows; the resulting path weight is a power of one unit scalar, with exponent equal to the number of selected arrows along the path.
